# https://www.qzzr.com llms.txt

> Qzzr is an online platform that enables users to create engaging quizzes and surveys easily. It offers a variety of features including customizable quiz templates, analytics to track responses, and integration options for sharing on social media. The site serves educators, marketers, and businesses looking to enhance engagement through interactive content.

- [Home](https://www.qzzr.com/): The main landing page showcasing the platform's features and benefits.

- [Contact Us](https://www.qzzr.com/contact-us/): A page with contact information and a form for inquiries.
- [Features](https://www.qzzr.com/features/): Highlights the various features available on the platform for quiz creation and management.
- [Free Quiz Maker](https://www.qzzr.com/free-quiz-maker/): A section dedicated to the free quiz-making tool available for users to start creating quizzes.

- [Pricing](https://www.qzzr.com/pricing/): An overview of the different pricing plans offered for using Qzzr's services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.qzzr.com/privacy-policy/): A document outlining how user data is collected, used, and protected.
